outcome.Summary: Implemented a mutex-guarded token-bucket rate limiter in ratelimit/limiter.go: New(rate, burst, clk) panics on rate<=0/burst<1, defaults to RealClock when clk is nil, and starts full; all time is read via the Clock interface. Allow/AllowN refill fractionally (capped at burst) then deduct tokens, AllowN handles n>burst (false) and n<=0 (true, no-op); Tokens() reports refilled balance; Reserve() overdraws to negative and returns the wait (1-tokens)/rate. Added ratelimit/limiter_test.go with a fake clock covering refill, capping, fractional waits, reservation semantics, arg panics, and concurrent use; `go test -race ./...` passes.
